prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE isolated production building sprite for tianshu default city-map. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_yamen, early-to-mid Qing northern China, generic county government compound, footprint17m east-west x13m north-south. Northern gray brick courtyard enclosure, dark gray tile roofs with modest hard gables and official front hall, three-bay main hall at rear, small side rooms, modest dark-red painted gate and pillars, very restrained blue-green painted beam trim, central stone court and a court drum. No yellow glazed tiles, no imperial dragons. South gate faces SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Camera ORTHOGRAPHIC yaw45 elevation30, exact 2:1 dimetric ground: front-left-to-front-corner edge slope+0.5, front-corner-to-right edge slope-0.5; keep both axes parallel, ground axis length ratio17:13. Thin flat rectangular ground footprint with left, front and right base corners unambiguously readable. NOT a thick diorama plinth. Realistic historical architectural sprite, hand-finished soft weathering, warm-neutral gray masonry and realistic small tiles, same detail density as supplied Song kit reference. Supplied image is only material/rendering/projection reference; replace pale Song plaster/timber with Qing northern gray brick and restrained official paint. Fully complete asset surrounded by at least10% transparent margin. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, no environment or checkerboard. Light SCREEN UPPER LEFT; tiny soft contact shadow SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. No text of any kind, no signboards, logos, characters, people, flags with symbols, modern objects, landscape, sky, horizon, roads, external trees, oversized curling eaves, perspective convergence or clipping. Original game interpretation, not a named historical monument. The 2:1 ratio describes the ground projection, not the canvas.
